title: Great visit to Seville!
text: Enrique showed us the highlights and unique spots of Seville. Palace and cathedral were amazing.  Our driver Daniel was fantastic!
author: Passenger758282

title: Best tour of our trip- left us wanting to return to see more of Seville!
text: Had an excellent tour with Nico who was so knowledgeable and professional- he made our journey through the streets exceptionally great. He was by far the guide with the most historical knowledge on our trip to Spain. More than that- he clearly loves his city and was great in conveying all there is to love to us- he had an extensive amount of information on not just the history but also took the time to show us all the hidden gems in the sights- from pointing out the sheer beauty of the various parks and commenting on the way the light changed and was highlighted by the architecture.
author: 282vanithap

title: Seville walking tour
text: I had a two-hour private walking tour in Seville with Abby. Abby was an amazing tour guide, friendly, open, and knowledgeable. She shared her knowledge of Andalusian culture and history with passion and was fun to walk around the city with her. She makes you feel more like a friend than a client. Thank you Abby for the beautiful experience.
author: Fatima-sa2022

title: The best introduction to Seville
text:
We enjoyed a 4 hour walking tour of Seville with Abby - well actually it was nearly 5 hours (hope her boss doesn't read this!)

Abby was so knowledgeable and passionate about Seville and so personable.  Our walking tour was on the first day of our holiday.  Without Abby's knowledge we would not have enjoyed our holiday so much.  For the remainder of our holiday we both repeated Abby's words so often.

We saw other walking tours with 20+ people with headphones.  Our tour was intimate with Abby talking to us directly.

The walking tour and Abby was one of the highlights of our holiday in Seville
author: K5023QXjennyc

title: Great intro to Seville
text: Excellent introduction to Seville for me, my wife, and young daughter on our first full day in the city. Juanjo met us promptly in front of the Alcazar and within a few minutes was walking us through the royal palace while talking about its history. He tells the story of the palace and the city in good detail and answered our questions well, including some left-field ones from our  9 year old.  Afterwards, he walked us around the old city center, Plaza Espana, and by the riverside, all the while engaging us in conversation about a city he knows well and cares for. title: Wonderful experience
text: We took a walking tour and our guide was excellent. Very knowledgeable about the history of the city and a great experience
author: deborah w

title: Excellent Overview of Seville
text: Our guide, Bastion, was terrific.  By showing us various sites, he covered the high points of the history of Seville, from its inception to present day.  And he pointed out things an average tourist would never see like the old warehouses used to store goods when Seville was a major port.  Highly recommended!
author: Gretchen B

title: Seville half-day walking tour
text: Juan Fernando was terrific.  What a great tour guide.  He was so informative about all the history and went at our pace.  It was a wonderful introduction to Seville and such a beautiful place to visit
author: Linda_K

title: Seville Tour & Pickup from Lagos, Portugal
text:

The driver was punctual and professional.
